fusions.name: Hoof Rain
fusions.desc: Stamps every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 7 damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Run Down
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 7 tiles to a target, then deals 16 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Tireless Plating
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 6s after you use it.

fusions.name: Second Wind
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
